title: Pentanuclear oxoalkoxide clusters of scandium, yttrium, indium and ytterbium, X-ray crystal structures of [M5(μ5-O)(μ3-OPri)4(μ2-OPri)4(OPri)5] (M = In, Yb)

synthesis.procedure: All operations under purified nitrogen (Schlenk apparatus and glove box). Method (a): sodium (5.0 g, 0.22 mol) was added to isopropanol (250 cm3) and heated under reflux for 2 h until the metal dissolved; after cooling to room temperature, a solution of anhydrous ScCl3 (11 g, 73 mmol) in isopropanol (250 cm3) was added. The mixture was heated under reflux for 2 h then stirred at room temperature for 60 h. The white precipitate was filtered off, solvent was removed in vacuo, and the residue was sublimed (220–280 °C/10−2 mm Hg). The sublimate was recrystallized from isopropanol to give white needle crystals of Sc5O(OPri)13 (2.5 g, 17% based on ScCl3). Method (b): (Me3Si)2NH (34.6 cm3, 164 mmol) was added to n-BuLi (53 cm3 of 3.15 M, 0.17 mol); solvent was removed and the residue dissolved in THF (100 cm3). ScCl3 (8.4 g, 56 mmol) in THF (100 cm3) was added dropwise, stirred overnight at room temperature, then the silylamide intermediate Sc[N(SiMe3)2]3 was isolated from pentane and sublimed at 110 °C/10−2 mm Hg (20.0 g, 69% based on ScCl3). Sublimate (8.5 g, 16 mmol) in benzene (250 cm3) was treated with isopropanol (20 cm3, ~fivefold excess), refluxed 1 h, solvents removed, and the residue recrystallized from isopropanol to give Sc5O(OPri)13 (2.1 g, 65% based on Sc[N(SiMe3)2]3).

synthesis.procedure: Under purified nitrogen. To yttrium powder (25 g, 0.28 mol) were added a few small crystals of HgCl2 followed by isopropanol (400 cm3, large excess). The mixture was heated under reflux for 60 h until most of the metal had dissolved; residual black solid was filtered off and discarded. Solvent was removed from the filtrate. A sample of the residue (6 g) was recrystallized from isopropanol to give white crystals of Y5O(OPri)13 (4.9 g, 7% based on Y). The bulk residue was sublimed at 220 °C/10−2 mm Hg (sublimed yield 22.2 g, 32% based on Y; combined yield 39%).

synthesis.yield: recrystallized sample 4.9 g (7% based on Y); sublimed 22.2 g (32% based on Y); combined 39%

synthesis.procedure: Under purified nitrogen. To ytterbium powder (10.2 g, 59 mmol) were added a few small crystals of HgCl2 followed by isopropanol (250 cm3, large excess). The contents were heated under reflux for 24 h. Residual black solid was filtered off and solvent was removed from the filtrate in vacuo. The white residue was sublimed at 215 °C/10−2 mm Hg as white crystals of Yb5O(OPri)13 (17.8 g, 86% based on Yb). M.p. > 300 °C. Crystals for X-ray work were sealed under nitrogen in thin-walled glass capillaries.
